text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bulgaria's President Petar Stoyanov says his country wants firmer ties with Gulf Arab states. Stoyanov will visit Kuwait on Monday.

- Officials from Iraq, Kuwait and its Gulf War allies to meet in Geneva under the auspices of the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) to discuss the issue of about 600 Kuwaitis missing since the 1991 war that ended Iraq's seven-month occupation of the Gulf state.
- Chaos at Kuwait's international airport due to a one-day strike by Kuwait Airways Corp pilots and engineers. The strike ended earlier on Wednesday.
- Kuwait's Acting Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah sends a message to Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister Prince Saud al-Faisal.
- Sheikh Sabah to chair a meeting of the Supreme Planning Council today (Wednesday).
- National Bank of Kuwait (NBK) starts property purchase financing service in Lebanon.
- Kuwait may permit the establishment of a private university, senior government official says.
- Nuisance callers to face questioning, Interior Ministry official says.
